$comment: The shape of data/vitals.json, with everything zeroed. The real file is written by scripts/collect.py and is gitignored. This exists so you can see what a collector is expected to produce, and so the HUD has something to describe before anything has run. Nothing reads this file.
$comment_community: Filled only if you drop a collector into plugins/collectors/. There is no built-in source for it, because every community platform is different. See plugins/collectors/community.example.py.
$comment_business: Optional, and there is no collector for it either. Add it from your own billing data if you want the ARR card to show something.
$comment_canary: Your own daily check-in, set from the command bar. Nothing fetches this.
